objective_vision_observations: This page contains four photographs arranged in a roughly rectangular shape with handwritten notes adjacent to or between the images. The top photo shows two planes on an airport tarmac near a hangar. The second, larger photo shows a man standing in the entrance of a brick building with several pieces of luggage, including large suitcases and smaller bags, stacked on a dolly and the ground near the door. Below that are three photos: two side-by-side images showing multiple boxes and bags on pavement outside at night, with one photo featuring a long rolled-up item strapped to a box labeled 'Reebok Core Board'. The third photo shows the rear of an SUV with its tailgate open, loaded with numerous cardboard boxes and bags. Several handwritten notes appear to the right and between the images, referring to switching planes and the amount of luggage visible.
